scenes.name: ONE DOT
lines: Picture one dot of light in a dark room. How far away is it? How big? Which way does it point?
想象暗室里只有一个光点。它离你多远？有多大？指向哪里？
Alone, it cannot say. There is nothing to hold it against.
它自己说不出来：没有任何东西可以拿来跟它比。

scenes.name: WHO MEASURED THE RULER
lines: So we reach for a ruler outside: a fixed grid, a third point to stand on.
于是我们去找一把外面的尺子：一张固定的网格，一个可以站上去的第三点。
But why do we believe that ruler is there? And who measured the ruler?
可我们凭什么相信那把尺子在那儿？尺子又是谁量的？

scenes.name: TWO THAT MEASURE
lines: Chinese hides a hint. In the word for quantum, the first character means an amount.
汉字里藏着一个提示：“量子”的“量”读 liàng，是一份数量。
Read it with a rising tone, and it means to measure: two that measure each other.
换成二声 liáng，它就是“丈量”：两个彼此丈量。

scenes.name: TWO ARROWS
lines: Draw two states as arrows of length one, a and b. Let a be the ruler.
把两个态画成两支长度为 1 的箭头 a 和 b，让 a 自己当尺子。
Think of a as a road. One step along b: how far down the road does it take you?
把 a 想成一条路，沿 b 迈出一步：这一步让你沿路走了多远？
Four fifths along, three fifths aside. The four fifths is the overlap, a dot b.
沿路五分之四步，向旁偏出五分之三步。这五分之四，就是重叠 a·b。
Square both: sixteen twenty-fifths plus nine twenty-fifths. Exactly one.
两个都平方：16/25 加 9/25，恰好是 1。
Lean checks the rule: the weight one state leaves on another's line is their overlap, squared.
Lean 检验的是规则：一个态落在另一个态那条线上的权重，就是两者重叠的模平方。
No judge in the middle: only two, and a shadow.
中间没有裁判：只有两个，和一道影子。

scenes.name: THE ROAD AHEAD
lines: That comparison is the seed. The film climbs from it, rung by rung.
这一次比较就是种子，整部片子从它出发，一级一级往上爬。
A point turns out to be a line, a line a plane, a plane a sphere.
点原来是线，线原来是面，面原来是球。
Then many spheres, the sphere of spacetime, and a step outside the sphere.
然后是多球、时空之球，再走到球外。
Then comparison as the ground, the return to the arc, observers in the field, and the observer as the field.
然后以比较立极，归于圆弧，观察者在场内，观察者即本体。
This ladder is the book's reading: a map, not a theorem.
这架梯子是本书的读法：是一张地图，不是定理。

scenes.name: NEXT QUESTION
lines: One catch. We drew both arrows on a grid we brought from outside.
只有一个破绽：我们是在一张从外面带来的网格上画这两支箭头的。
With no ruler outside, how can one state measure another?
外面没有尺子，一个态怎么丈量另一个态？

scenes.name: ONE RULER
lines: No ruler outside? Then let one arrow be the ruler for the other.
外面没有尺子？那就让一支箭头给另一支当尺子。
Turn the whole room back and forth. The angle between the two arrows never moves.
把整间屋子来回转，两支箭头之间的夹角都不动。
We used no frame and no third point. The angle belongs to the pair.
没用坐标架，也没用第三个点：夹角只属于这一对。

chapter.en: Part I · Breaking illusions: from point to line
chapter.zh: 第一部 · 破妄·从点到线

scenes.name: THE SHADOW
lines: Shine a light straight down onto the ruler, and b casts a shadow along it.
从尺子正上方打一束光，b 在尺子上投下一道影子。
That shadow is the overlap, cosine theta. Here it is exactly zero point six.
影子的长度就是重叠 cos θ。这里恰好是 0.6。

scenes.name: SQUARE THE SHADOW
lines: Now ask b a yes or no question: are you a?
现在问 b 一个是非题：你是 a 吗？
Yes gets weight zero point three six, the shadow squared. No gets zero point six four.
“是”的权重是 0.36，正是影子的平方；“否”得 0.64。
Why squares? Among all powers of the shadow, only the square adds up to one.
为什么是平方？在影子的各次幂里，只有平方加起来恒为 1。
Lean checks the rule: a one-line record, read on a pure state, weighs the overlap squared.
Lean 内核检验：单线记录作用在纯态上，权重是重叠的模平方。
We like to think probability lives inside the particle. It does not. A probability is a meeting of two.
我们总以为概率藏在粒子内部。并不是：概率是两者的相遇。

scenes.name: SIFT TWICE
lines: Suppose the answer is yes. The record keeps the shadow on a, and drops the rest.
假设答案是“是”。记录留下落在 a 上的影子，其余扔掉。
Ask again with the same ruler. Yes, for certain, and nothing more is dropped.
用同一把尺子再问一次：一定是“是”，再也扔不掉什么。
Like a sieve: what passed once passes again. In symbols, P squared equals P.
像筛子：筛过一次的，再筛还能过。写成符号：P² = P。
How do we know a thing is there at all? Because asking twice gives the same answer.
凭什么说一样东西“在那里”？因为问两遍，答案一样。

scenes.name: LOOK AWAY
lines: Now record the answer, but let nobody read it.
现在把答案记下来，但谁也不去读。
The state becomes a blend: zero point three six of yes, zero point six four of no.
态变成一份混合：0.36 的“是”，0.64 的“否”。
In its matrix, the two corners, zero point four eight each, are wiped to zero.
在它的矩阵里，两个角上的 0.48 被抹成零。
Lean checks the books: the total splits exactly into what stays and what was wiped. Unread twice is just unread once.
Lean 内核检验这本账：总量恰好分成留下的与抹掉的；未读两次，就是未读一次。
On the Bloch disk, the arrow pulls in off the rim, onto the yes or no axis: length one becomes zero point two eight.
在布洛赫圆盘上，箭头离开边缘，收到“是—否”轴上：长度从 1 变成 0.28。

scenes.name: NEXT QUESTION
lines: Part One climbed from a point to a line: a pair, a shadow, a square, a sieve, a fade.
第一部从点走到了线：一对、一道影子、一个平方、一只筛子、一次淡出。
But each number here only says how much. None of them can turn.
可这里的每个数都只说“有多少”，没有一个会转。
A line can tell how much. Where does the turning live?
线只说得出“有多少”。转动藏在哪里？

scenes.name: WHICH WAY TO TURN
lines: A shadow says how much one arrow leans on another. It cannot say which way to turn.
影子能告诉你一支箭头有多少落在另一支上，却说不出该往哪边转。
Spin a pencil on a table: you need the tabletop. Turning lives in a plane.
在桌上转一支铅笔：离不开桌面。转动住在面里。
One arrow gives a line. Two arrows that disagree give a plane, and an area between them.
一支箭头只给出一条线；两支方向不同的箭头，才张出一个面，夹出一块面积。

chapter.en: Part II · Unfolding wings: from line to plane
chapter.zh: 第二部 · 展翼·从线到面

scenes.name: THE QUARTER TURN
lines: Point a clock hand east. Give it a quarter turn: it points north. Another quarter turn: west.
让表针指向东。转四分之一圈，指北；再转四分之一圈，指西。
Call one quarter turn I. Two of them: I times I is minus one.
把四分之一圈记作 I。转两次：I 乘 I 就是 −1。
We called it imaginary only because we never drew the plane.
我们叫它“虚数”，只因为从没画出那个面。
Lean checks the matrix version: build J from balanced halves whose cross terms cancel, and J squared is minus one.
Lean 检验矩阵版本：交叉项相消的两个平衡半分量造出 J，J² 是负单位阵。

scenes.name: LINE PLUS AREA
lines: Take arrows three-one and one-three. Dot product: six. The parallelogram they span: area eight.
取箭头 (3, 1) 与 (1, 3)。点积：6。它们张成的平行四边形：面积 8。
Squared lengths: ten times ten is a hundred, and six squared plus eight squared is a hundred too.
Lean checks it for all real lists: squared lengths multiplied, minus the dot squared, equals the squared plane areas, summed.
Lean 对任意两组实数检验：长度平方之积减点积平方，等于坐标面面积平方和。
So one product holds both: A B is A dot B plus A wedge B. Here, six plus eight I.
于是一个乘积装下两半：AB = A·B + A∧B。这里就是 6 + 8I。
In the book's reading, the line is the particle you count; the area is the wave that turns.
本书的读法：线是被计数的粒子，面积是会转动的波。

scenes.name: TWO KINDS OF TIME
lines: Let the area sweep. A turning arrow is quantum time: smooth, and able to run backwards.
让面积扫过去。转动的箭头是量子时间：平滑，也能倒着走。
A clock tick is a line, a record. Two records are fully distinct only when perpendicular.
钟的一声滴答是一条线，一条记录。两条记录只有互相垂直，才能完全分开。
So each tick climbs a ninety-degree wall, like a revolving door swinging a full quarter turn.
所以每声滴答都要翻过 90° 的墙，像旋转门，每放一人都得整整转四分之一圈。
Lean checks the consequence: a state within E tau over h-bar of two perpendicular records forces tau to be at least pi h-bar over four E.
Lean 检验其推论：一个态到两条垂直记录的夹角都不超过 Eτ/ħ，则 τ ≥ πħ/(4E)。

scenes.name: THE PRICE OF WIPING
lines: Turning can be undone. Flattening cannot: squash the arrow onto its line, and the sideways area is gone.
转动能撤销，压扁却不能：把箭头压到它的线上，横向那块面积就没了。
For a balanced arrow, entropy climbs from zero to log two. No heat is paid yet.
对两边均衡的箭头，熵从 0 升到 ln 2 ≈ 0.693；这一步还不付热。
To reuse the record, reset it, as an eraser turns marks into crumbs and warmth. That entropy drop costs heat.
要再用这条记录就得复位，像橡皮把印记变成碎屑和热：熵往下降，这一降才要付热。
Lean checks the bookkeeping: if heat equals the entropy drop plus two non-negative extras, heat is at least the drop.
Lean 检验了这笔账：若热量等于熵减加上两项非负的余项，热量就不小于熵减。
The book reads this as the arrow of time: turning runs both ways, but resetting a record sends a bill.
本书在这里读出时间之箭：转动可以双向，复位记录却总要寄来账单。

scenes.name: ONE TURN TOO FEW
lines: In four strokes: i is a quarter turn; the product is line plus area; area is quantum time; resetting costs heat.
四笔说完：i 是四分之一圈，几何积是线加面积，面积是量子时间，复位要付热。
But in a plane, an arrow has room for only one perpendicular partner.
可是在一个平面里，一支箭头只容得下一个垂直的伙伴。
Two directions make a plane. What do three make?
两个方向张成一个面。三个呢？

scenes.name: THREE AXES
lines: Stand a third pencil square to the first two. Now every pair spans its own turning plane.
再立第三支铅笔，与前两支都成直角。现在每两支之间，都张开一块自己的转动面。
One plane only draws a circle. Three planes at right angles close into a sphere.
一块面只画得出一个圆；三块面以直角扣在一起，就合拢成一颗球。

chapter.zh: 第三部 · 合拢·从面到球

scenes.name: TWO ANGLES
lines: From the north pole, tilt sixty degrees down a meridian. Your height drops to one half.
从北极出发，沿经线倾转 60°，高度就降到二分之一。
Then twist forty-five degrees about the vertical. The height stays; you land on one exact point.
再绕竖轴拧转 45°。高度不变，落在一个确定的点上。
Latitude and longitude: one right angle picks the circle, the second picks the place.
这就是纬度和经度：正交一次选定纬度圈，正交两次选定圈上的位置。
Axes need not be square: Lean checks that any two not on one line build every rotation in finitely many turns.
轴不必垂直。Lean 检验：两根不共线的轴，有限次转动就拼得出任何转动。

scenes.name: ORDER
lines: But a quarter turn about Y, then X, stops at plus X. Swap the order: minus Y.
可是先绕 Y、再绕 X 各转四分之一圈，停在 +X；换个次序，却停在 −Y。
So why do we believe order rules the quantum? Order belongs to the doing, not to the comparing.
那我们凭什么相信顺序主宰量子？顺序属于动作，不属于比较。

scenes.name: THE TABLE
lines: Take three states: the north pole, plus X, and our new point. Compare each pair once.
取三个态：北极、+X 和刚才那个点。每两个只比一次。
Born weights: one half, three quarters, about point eight one. Read the table in any order; nothing changes.
玻恩权重：1/2、3/4，约 0.81。按什么次序读这张表，都不会变。
Lean checks the strong form: families with the same complex table differ by one common turn.
Lean 检验了强的说法：两族态的复内积表相同，它们就只差一个公共的转动。
Like distances between towns: they fix the map, except where you slide and turn it.
就像城镇之间的距离：它们定死了整张地图，只差你把它挪到哪、转多少。

scenes.name: PULSE AND PHASE
lines: In the lab, a sideways turn is a microwave pulse; the angle is the area under it.
在实验室里，往侧面转是打一个微波脉冲；转角就是包络下的面积。
Ten megahertz for twenty-five nanoseconds makes pi over two: pole to equator.
10 MHz 打 25 ns，面积是 π/2：从极点转到赤道。
A turn about the vertical takes no time. The software just shifts the phase of later pulses.
绕竖轴转，一点时间都不花：软件只是把后面脉冲的相位挪一挪。
Like turning the map, not walking. Lean checks the general rule: push the state forward or pull the measurement back, same reading.
就像转地图而不走路。Lean 检验一般规律：态往前推或测量往回拉，读数相同。

scenes.name: MEASURING COMPUTES
lines: The boldest step: link two qubits, then measure only the first, at an angle alpha on its equator.
最大胆的一步：把两个量子比特连起来，然后只测第一个，沿它赤道上的角 α。
The second receives a gate: a turn set by alpha, a Hadamard, and a known flip if you read one.
第二个收到一扇门：由 α 定的转动加阿达马门；读到 1 时再多一个已知翻转。
Each result weighs one half; Lean checks that the branch weights of any complete projective measurement add up to the trace.
每个结果各占一半。Lean 检验：任意完备投影测量的分支权重之和等于迹。
The links are laid like rails; each measurement throws a switch. Where you look is what you compute.
链接像铁轨一样事先铺好，每次测量都扳动一个道岔。你往哪里看，就算了什么。

scenes.name: ONE SPHERE CLOSED
lines: One sphere is closed: every state addressed, every comparison agreeing, and a gate can be a pulse, a phase, or a glance.
一颗球就此合拢：态都有地址，比较总一致；门可以是脉冲、相位，或一次注视。
We just linked two spheres, and never asked what the link is.
我们刚把两颗球连在一起，却从没问过，那根链接到底是什么。
What happens when two spheres share one state?
两个球共享一个态时，会发生什么？

scenes.name: TWO SPHERES, ONE STATE
lines: Give two spheres one state, and look at each alone: both arrows shrink to the centre.
让两个球共享一个态，再单独看每一个：两根箭头都缩到了球心。
The whole is pure, yet Alice's half is one half the identity. Lean checks it.
整体是纯态，Alice 那一半却是 ½ 乘单位阵。这由 Lean 检验。
The information lives in agreement: both along Z, or both along X, they match.
信息活在两者的一致里：都沿 Z 测，或都沿 X 测，读数永远相同。
Like a handshake, it is in neither hand.
像一次握手，它不在任何一只手里。

chapter.zh: 第四部 · 交织·多球共振

scenes.name: BELL AT 45°
lines: Could that match be a script written in advance? Bell made it a score.
这种一致会不会是事先写好的剧本？贝尔把这个怀疑变成了一道打分题。
Alice measures along Z or X. Bob turns his pair forty-five degrees.
Alice 沿 Z 或 X 测；Bob 把自己那对方向转过 45°。
Three pairs agree by point seven oh seven, the last by minus point seven oh seven.
三对的关联是 0.707，最后一对是 −0.707。
Subtract the last: two root two, about two point eight three.
减去最后一项：得分 2√2 ≈ 2.83。
Any script, or mix of scripts, scores at most two. Lean checks it.
任何剧本，或剧本的任意混合，最多得 2。这由 Lean 检验。
Lean also checks that no state beats two root two here. The arc beats the line.
Lean 还检验了：在这道题上，没有态能超过 2√2。圆弧赢了直线。

scenes.name: HIDE, DON'T COPY
lines: Shared states are fragile. Why not back them up? A quantum machine is a rigid turn: it keeps overlaps.
共享的态很脆弱，为什么不备份？可量子机器是一次刚性转动：它保留内积。
Overlap point six stays point six, but the copies would need point three six.
内积 0.6 仍是 0.6，复本却需要 0.36。
A number equals its square only at zero or one. Lean checks: one machine copies two states only if they are identical or perpendicular.
一个数等于自己的平方，只能是 0 或 1。Lean 检验：同一台机器能复制的两个态，只能相同或正交。
So we hide instead: three qubits give eight dimensions, four perpendicular planes.
那就改为藏起来：三个比特张成八维，切成四个互相垂直的平面。
A bit flip moves the whole plane. We ask which plane, never what's inside, and move it back.
比特翻转把整个平面搬走。我们只问在哪个平面，从不问里面是什么，再把它搬回来。

scenes.name: TWO MIRRORS
lines: Hidden states can still be steered: a prize in one of four boxes, one half in each.
藏起来的态依然可以操控。把奖品藏进四个盒子之一，每个盒子先放 ½。
Mirror one flips the prize. Mirror two flips each amplitude about the average.
第一面镜子翻转奖品；第二面镜子把每个振幅关于平均值翻转。
One half each becomes one, zero, zero, zero: the prize, for certain, in one step.
四个 ½ 变成 1、0、0、0：一步之后，奖品确定无疑。
Two mirrors make a turn. Lean checks: after n steps, the prize part is sine of two n plus one theta.
两面镜子合成一次转动。Lean 检验：n 步之后，奖品分量是 sin((2n + 1)θ)。

scenes.name: ONE POLYNOMIAL
lines: Grover's turn is one case of a bigger trick: hide x in a turn, as its cosine.
Grover 的转动只是更大技巧的一例：把 x 藏进一次转动，作为它的余弦。
Turn it again and again; the corner reads one, point six, minus point two eight, minus point nine three six.
Each is two x times the last, minus the one before; it follows from a power-sum rule Lean checks.
每个读数等于 2x 乘上一个，再减去前一个；它来自一条由 Lean 检验的幂和规则。
Twist the phases between turns: Lean checks the right polynomials can all be built. Search and simulation as one recipe is the literature's claim.
在转动之间拧相位：Lean 检验了合格的多项式都能这样拼出来。把搜索、模拟归为同一张配方，是文献的说法。

scenes.name: WOVEN
lines: The whole is not stored in the parts. It is woven between them.
整体不存在零件里，而是编织在零件之间。
Yet every turn here ticked on one shared clock, in one fixed space.
可这里的每一次转动，都踩着同一只钟，在同一个固定的空间里。
If spheres can be woven together, can space and time be woven too?
球能彼此编织，时间与空间也能吗？

scenes.name: A TURN THAT NEVER CLOSES
lines: So far the weave was all space. Now let a clock in, and see what bends.
到目前为止，织进来的都是空间。现在让一只钟也进来，看看什么会弯。
Turn an event, and it rides a circle. Push it, and it rides a hyperbola, hugging the light cone, never crossing it.
转动一个事件，它沿圆走；推动它，它沿双曲线走，贴着光锥，永远跨不过去。

chapter.zh: 第五部 · 显影·时空之球

scenes.name: LIGHT MEASURES ZERO
lines: Why should time subtract, when space adds? Because light must measure zero, in every frame.
空间里是相加，时间凭什么相减？因为光在任何参考系里都必须量出零。
Lean checks it: any quadratic rule that is zero on every light ray is t squared minus x squared, times one number.
Lean 检验了：凡是在每条光线上都为零的二次型，都是 t² − x² 乘上一个数。

scenes.name: RAPIDITY BY HAND
lines: Push with rapidity log two. Cosh is five quarters, sinh three quarters, and the speed three fifths of light.
以快度 ln 2 推一下：cosh 是 5/4，sinh 是 3/4，速度是光速的 3/5。
Twenty-five sixteenths minus nine sixteenths is one. Lean checks cosh squared minus sinh squared is one, for every real.
25/16 减 9/16 等于 1。Lean 检验了：对每个实数，cosh² 减 sinh² 都等于 1。
Push twice: fifteen seventeenths, not six fifths. Speeds do not add. Rapidities do.
再推一次：速度是光速的 15/17，不是 6/5。速度不相加，快度才相加。

scenes.name: WHAT A LOOP KEEPS
lines: Now carry a phase around a block. Think of changing money: each town may rename its currency.
现在带着一个相位绕街区一圈。好比一路换钱：每个小镇都可以给自己的货币改名。
The streets read one, one, one, i. Rename three corners, and they read i, i, i, minus one.
四条街原来读作 1、1、1、i；给三个路口改名，就读作 i、i、i、−1。
Around the block the product is i, both times. Renaming moves the phase. It cannot erase it.
绕一圈的乘积，两次都是 i。改名能挪动相位，却抹不掉它。
Lean checks, on any connected finite graph with one anchor: loop phases agree exactly when one rename links the two fields.
Lean 检验了：单锚点的连通有限图上，回路相位相同，当且仅当两场只差一次改名。
Physicists read that leftover turn as a force. A force is what a loop cannot forget.
物理学家把这份剩下的转角读作力。力，就是回路忘不掉的东西。

scenes.name: THE NARROWEST WAIST
lines: Weave such pieces into a network. How much gets through? Ask a stadium crowd: the narrowest gate decides.
把这样的小块织成网络，能穿过去多少？问问散场的人群：最窄的那道门说了算。
Legs of sizes two, three, two, three. Cut widths multiply: exits six, entrances six, leg a, the bridges and leg c, twelve.
腿是 2、3、2、3。割的宽度相乘：出口 6，入口 6，切过腿 a、三座桥和腿 c 是 12。
Lean checks that the rank never exceeds the smallest cut, for every size. And here it reaches it: six.
Lean 检验了：对所有尺寸，秩都不超过最小割；而在这里，它正好达到：6。
Holography turns this into a law of areas. That step is literature, not proved here.
全息理论把它推成一条面积定律；那一步是文献结果，本书没有证明。

scenes.name: WORK THAT KEEPS GROWING
lines: Last, count the work. Twelve gates on eleven sites. Like cooks sharing a burner, gates sharing a site take turns.
最后，数一数功夫。十一个格点上十二道门。好比厨师共用灶眼，共用格点的门只能轮流。
Two turning points cut the chain into three pieces, side by side. Twelve gates, four ticks.
两个折返点把链切成并排的三段。十二道门，四拍。
Lean checks the rule: the least depth is N divided by kappa-plus-one, rounded down, then plus one. Here, three plus one.
Lean 检验了这条规律：最小深度是 N 除以 κ + 1 向下取整，再加 1。这里是 3 加 1。
Near black holes, complexity is said to grow like volume after entanglement stops. That guess is still open.
有人说，在黑洞附近，纠缠停下之后，复杂度仍像体积一样增长。这个猜想至今未决。

scenes.name: FROM INSIDE
lines: Clocks, loops, waists and ticks: each was measured from inside the sphere.
钟、回路、瓶颈与节拍：每一样，都是在球的里面量出来的。
Can a sphere ever see itself from outside?
一个球能从外面看见自己吗？

scenes.name: THE WHOLE LIST
lines: Try a list: every endless row of bits, one per line, and call that list the whole sphere.
做个试验：把所有无穷长的比特行一行一行列出来，管这张清单叫“整个球”。
To see itself whole, it must also hold every row built from itself.
要看全自己，它就得把由它自己造出的每一行也装进去。

chapter.zh: 第六部 · 越界·球外之球

scenes.name: DIAGONAL
lines: Walk down the diagonal and flip each bit you meet.
沿对角线往下走，遇到一位就翻一位。
The new row differs from row k in place k.
新的一行在第 k 位上和第 k 行不同。
So it is nowhere in the list. Lean checks this for any twist that changes every value.
所以它不在清单里。Lean 对任何“改动每个值”的翻转都检查了这一点。
Add it to the list; the new diagonal escapes again. Gödel used the same kind of move.
把它收进清单，新的对角线又逃出去。哥德尔用的是同一类招数。
However full the list, it does not seal the sphere. It pushes the diagonal out.
再满的清单也封不住球，只会把对角线顶出去。

scenes.name: THE CRACK
lines: Finite tools leave a crack as well. Tile a round dome with flat tiles, and a gap always shows.
有限的工具也总留一道缝。拿平瓷砖去贴圆屋顶，总有缝露出来。
Quadruple the sides and the gap shrinks about sixteen-fold, but it never closes.
边数翻四倍，缝大约缩小十六倍，却永远合不上。

scenes.name: PRIME AXES
lines: Counting has no final list either. When we multiply, each prime is its own street.
数数也没有最后一张清单。做乘法时，每个素数都是一条独立的街。
Right is times two, up is times three. Twelve sits two blocks right, one block up.
向右是乘 2，向上是乘 3。12 就在向右两格、向上一格的路口。
No pile of twos ever equals a pile of threes; Lean checks that prime logarithms are independent over whole numbers.
再多的 2 也凑不成一堆 3；Lean 检查了素数的对数在整数系数下彼此独立。
Seven already lies off the map of two, three and five, and the primes never run out.
7 已经落在 2、3、5 画出的地图之外，而素数永远用不完。
Their rhythm sits in zeta's nontrivial zeros; an external Lean proof puts them all on the critical line.
节奏藏在 ζ 的非平凡零点里；一份外部 Lean 证明把它们全放在临界线上。

scenes.name: COS θ = θ
lines: Must chases run forever? Enter zero in radians and press cosine, again and again.
追逐一定没完没了吗？在弧度制下输入 0，一遍又一遍按余弦。
One, point five four, point eight six, point six five: swinging left and right, closing in.
The readings settle near point seven three nine, the angle equal to its own cosine.
读数停在 0.739 附近：这个角恰好等于它自己的余弦。
Lean checks that exactly one positive angle does this, and that it lies between zero and one.
Lean 检查了：恰好只有一个正角做到这一点，而且它在 0 和 1 之间。
Yet no finite number of presses lands on it exactly.
可是按有限多次，永远不会正好落在它上面。

scenes.name: ψ = ψ(ψ)
lines: What would it take for a chase to stop, when the diagonal never could?
追逐要怎样才能停下？对角线可从来停不下。
Lean's answer: a list can catch its own twisted diagonal only where the twist leaves a value alone.
Lean 的答案：清单只能在扭转放过某个值的地方，接住自己扭过的对角线。
A bit flip changes every value, so it never lands. Cosine leaves one angle alone.
翻比特会改动每个值，所以永远落不下；余弦却放过了一个角。
Read the landing row as psi, and its address as psi's own name. The book writes: psi equals psi of psi.
把落点那一行读作 ψ，把它的地址读作 ψ 自己的名字，本书写成：ψ = ψ(ψ)。
A chase stops only where the twist leaves something alone.
追逐只停在扭转放过的地方。
If every escape lands on a new sphere, what can we stand on?
每次逃出都落在新的球上，那我们还能站在什么上面？

scenes.name: NOTHING BUT COMPARISONS
lines: Sphere after sphere, no floor is final. So stand on what every sphere keeps: comparisons.
一层球外还有一层球，没有哪层地板是最后的。那就站在每层球都保留的东西上：比较。
Take three states and write down only how much each pair agrees. No clock, no outside frame.
取三个态，只记下每两个之间有多相融。没有钟，也没有外部坐标。

chapter.en: Part VII · Foundations: comparison as the ground
chapter.zh: 第七部 · 立极·以比较为地基

scenes.name: A CHART WITHOUT A MAP
lines: Think of a mileage chart for three towns, printed without a map.
好比一张三座小镇之间的里程表，印出来时没有附地图。
A and B agree by one half, B and C by one half, but A and C are opposites.
A 与 B 的相融度是 1/2，B 与 C 也是 1/2，A 与 C 却正好相反，是 −1。
Measure the arrow A minus B plus C. Its squared length is three, minus one, minus two, minus one.
量一量 A − B + C 这根箭头：长度平方是 3 − 1 − 2 − 1。
That is minus one. No length squares to a negative, so no three states fit this chart.
结果是 −1。没有哪个长度的平方是负数，所以没有任何三个态符合这张表。

scenes.name: THE WINDOW
lines: Slide that entry. The chart holds together only between minus one half and one.
滑动这一格：只有在 −1/2 到 1 之间，这张表才站得住。
At minus one half, the three fall flat into one plane, and B is exactly A plus C.
到 −1/2 时，三个态压进同一个平面，B 恰好等于 A + C。
Lean checks the general rule: a table gives no negative length for every arrow exactly when it is a table of overlaps.
Lean 检验了一般规律：一张表对每一根箭头都量出非负长度，当且仅当它确实是一张内积表。
No entry came first. They fit all at once. Causes do not push; they fit.
没有哪一格先发生，它们同时嵌合。因果不是推出来的，是嵌合出来的。

scenes.name: FIELD AND LINE
lines: Now a different puzzle. Checking a colored map is quick. Coloring one may not be.
换一个谜题。检查一张涂好色的图很快；把它涂出来却未必。
Color a ring of five so that neighbors differ. Three colors work: a field, set all at once.
给五个点围成的环着色，让相邻两点颜色不同。三种颜色就够：这是一片场，一下子全部定好。
Point each edge toward the higher color, and every arrow chain stops within three points: a line.
让每条边指向号数更大的颜色，任何一串箭头都不超过三个点：这是一条线。
Lean checks they always come together: k colors exist exactly when some arrows keep every chain within k points.
Lean 检验了二者总是相伴：能用 k 种颜色着色，当且仅当有一种定向让每串箭头都不超过 k 个点。
But whether finding is ever as easy as checking, P versus NP, is still open.
但“找”是否总能和“验”一样容易，即 P 与 NP 问题，至今仍未解决。

scenes.name: LEDGERS THAT NEVER CHEAT
lines: The book reads quantum rules as five ledgers that never cheat.
本书把量子规则读作五本从不作弊的账。
Open the copy ledger. A reversible copier must leave every entry of our table alone, yet copying squares each entry.
翻开复印这本账：可逆的复印机必须让表里每一格原样不动，可复印却把每一格平方。
So one entry would read one half before and one quarter after. The table cannot stand.
于是同一格复印前是 1/2，复印后是 1/4。这张表站不住。
Lean checks the only way out: the overlap equals its square, so the states are equal or perpendicular.
Lean 检验了唯一的出路：重叠度等于它自己的平方，所以两个态要么相同，要么正交。

scenes.name: THE COMPARISON AXIOM
lines: So the book lays one stone at the bottom: all is pairwise comparison, with no third point.
于是本书在最底下放一块基石：一切都是两两比较，不借第三点。
Two worlds that agree on every comparison differ only by turning everything at once.
在每一次比较上都一致的两个世界，最多只差整体转一下。
Lean checks it: equal overlap tables mean one unitary carries one family onto the other.
Lean 检验了这一点：内积表相同，就有一个幺正变换把一组态整体搬到另一组上。
And a turn of everything is a turn no one inside can see.
而整体的转动，身在其中的谁也看不见。
If comparing is all there is, what is the smallest thing it can see?
如果只剩比较，它能看见的最小单位是什么？

scenes.name: THE SMALLEST CELL
lines: Ask comparison for its finest grain, and it hands you no dot. It hands you one small cell.
让比较交出最细的颗粒，它给你的不是一个点，而是一个小胞。
Like a corner cut from an orange: three flat faces meet at the centre, and the peel stays curved.
像从橙子上切下的一角：三个平切面交于中心，橙皮仍是弯的。

chapter.en: Part VIII · Down to the smallest arc
chapter.zh: 第八部 · 造微与归弧

scenes.name: ONE STEP OR TWO
lines: Walk from A to C: one straight step, or two forty-five degree steps with a square turn at B.
从 A 到 C：沿大圆一步直达；或者走两段 45° 的弧，在 B 处直角转弯。
Compare in pairs. A with B gives 0.707, B with C too, and A with C one half, 0.707 squared.
只做两两比较：A 比 B 得 0.707，B 比 C 也是，A 比 C 得 1/2，正是 0.707 的平方。
Lean checks one ledger for any three arrows. Here it reads 0.729 plus 0.125 i, the volume hiding in the i.
Lean 对任意三根箭头核验同一本账：这里读出 0.729 + 0.125i，体积就藏在虚部里。

scenes.name: TURN, DON'T SUBTRACT
lines: Why did we ever believe that a small enough step is straight?
我们凭什么相信：步子够小，就是直的？
Turn a point by theta. It slides sine theta, and drops one minus cosine theta: the sagitta, the arrow inside a bow.
把一点转过 θ：它横移 sin θ，下沉 1 − cos θ，这就是矢高，弓里搭着的那支箭。
A hundred turns of zero point one drop 0.4996 in all. Old calculus throws that away.
转 100 次、每次 0.1，矢高累计 0.4996。旧微积分把它扔掉了。
Lean checks: steps shrinking faster than one over root N leave nothing; exactly that fast, half of sigma squared T.
Lean 核验：步子缩得比 1/√N 快，什么也不剩；恰好这么快，剩下 σ²T 的一半。

scenes.name: PRIMES AS ARCS
lines: Whole numbers hide turns too. Adding over all numbers equals multiplying one factor per prime.
整数里也藏着转动：对全体整数求和，等于每个素数各乘一个因子。
Lean checks it when the real part of s is above one.
Lean 在实部大于 1 时核验了它。
Add an imaginary part, and each prime turns like a clock, at speed log p.
加上虚部，每个素数像一只钟，以速度 ln p 转动。
The Riemann hypothesis puts every nontrivial zero on the line where the real part is one half.
黎曼猜想说：每个非平凡零点都落在实部为 1/2 的那条线上。
It has an external Lean proof, independently replayed, not frozen in this book's own library.
它已有外部 Lean 证明并经独立重放，但没有冻结在本书自己的库里。

scenes.name: THREE WON'T CLOSE
lines: Turns in a plane multiply like complex numbers. In space, take a as one, two, two, and b as zero, three, four.
平面里的转动像复数一样相乘。到了空间，取 a = (1, 2, 2)，b = (0, 3, 4)。
Their cross product measures the area; squared, that is just twenty-nine of fifteen squared. The missing 196 is the overlap, fourteen squared.
叉积的长度是面积，平方后只有 29，而 15² 是 225；少掉的 196 是重叠 14 的平方。
Lean checks this receipt for any two lists. A three-drawer cabinet has no drawer for the overlap.
Lean 对任意两组数核验了这张收据。三个抽屉的柜子，放不下重叠。
Give it a fourth drawer, and the product closes, with length fifteen, three times five.
给它第四格，乘法就合拢了，长度正好 15 = 3 × 5。

scenes.name: EVERY FORCE, AN ARC
lines: Then the book's boldest reading, marked as a model: a gauge force is the turn a loop brings back inside one cell.
接着是本书最大胆的诠释，标为模型：规范力，是小胞里绕一圈带回来的转角。
Gravity is a shared metronome between cells, ticking slower where they crowd. Einstein's constant and the three generations stay open.
引力是小胞间共用的节拍器，越挤越慢；爱因斯坦常数与三代粒子仍开放。

scenes.name: WHO COMPARES
lines: So comparison's smallest unit is a curved cell. But comparing needs a comparer, and no outside is left to stand on.
所以，比较的最小单位是一个弯曲的小胞。可是比较需要比较者，而外面已无处可站。
Who does the comparing, from inside the field?
在场的里面，是谁在比较？

scenes.name: EVERYTHING THAT COMPARES
lines: Nobody stands outside to watch the rain hit this pebble. So who is comparing?
雨点打在这颗石子上，没人站在外面看。那么，是谁在比较？
The drop and the pebble compare each other, and the pebble keeps the dent.
雨点与石子相互比量，石子留下了凹痕。
A photon compares and passes the phase on, keeping nothing; you keep years.
光子也比较，却只把相位传下去，什么都不留；你能记住许多年。
Why do we assume an observer needs a brain? A brain is only a deeper memory.
凭什么认定观察者非得有大脑？大脑不过是记得更深。
This book reads everything that compares as an observer; only the memory order differs. That is a model.
本书把一切会比较的都读作观察者，差别只在记忆阶数。这是模型诠释。

chapter.en: Part IX · Observers inside the field
chapter.zh: 第九部 · 互照与破执·场内观察者

scenes.name: EVERY HAND LETS GO
lines: Now count what keeping costs. A qubit in even superposition links its two branches by one half.
那就算一算“留下”的代价。均匀叠加的量子比特，两条分支由二分之一连着。
Two holders each take a phase record, a quarter turn apiece, and the link becomes minus one half.
两个持有者各取一份相位记录，各转四分之一圈，这个连接变成负二分之一。
One lets go: minus i over two. Both let go: one half again. Lean checks these four values.
一方松手：−i/2；双方都松手：又回到 ½。这四个值由 Lean 核验。
Keep one copy whose overlap is not one, let the pure phase copies go; Lean checks a nonzero link never returns.
留一份重叠不等于 1 的副本，让纯相位副本全部松手：Lean 核验，原本不为零的连接再也回不来。
To unmake a fact, every hand must let go.
要抹去一个事实，得让每一只手都松开。

scenes.name: OPEN THE GATES
lines: So the past stays put, one cell per moment. How does an observer move through it?
于是过去留在原地，每个时刻一格。观察者又怎样在其中穿行？
Picture eight fields watered through a delta of sluice gates.
想象八块田，由一片分叉的水闸渠网灌溉。
The address zero, one, one turns three gates, and only field three gets water.
地址 0 1 1 转动三道闸门，只有第 3 块田得到水。
With clean wires, reading adds that field's eight to the register and leaves the address and wires as they were.
线路干净时，读出把这块田里的 8 加进寄存器，地址与线路原样不动。
Lean checks this at every depth. Time as a pointer over still memory is the book's model.
Lean 核验了任意深度的这套路由。把时间读作静止存储上的指针，是本书的模型。

scenes.name: THE TAUT STRING
lines: Then the pointer moves from moment three to moment four. Which way should the state walk?
随后指针从时刻 3 走到时刻 4。态该沿哪条路走？
Stretch a string tight across a ball: it settles on the shortest arc, never through the inside.
在球面上拉紧一根绳，它会落在最短的弧上，绝不穿进球里。
Two states sit eighty degrees apart; a stop fifty degrees off the arc makes the trip one hundred twenty-one.
两个态相距 80°；中途绕到偏离这段弧 50° 的地方，路程变成 121°。
Lean checks the direct angle never exceeds the two legs.
Lean 核验：直达的夹角从不超过两段之和。
Walked through filters, four even steps keep sixty-one percent; one eighty-degree leap keeps three.
用滤片沿弧走：四个均匀的步留下 61%；一步跳 80° 只留下 3%。
Each share is a squared overlap, the record weight Lean checks. Even steps as good thinking is a model.
每一份留下的都是重叠的平方，即 Lean 核验的记录权重。把均匀的步读作好的思考，是模型。

scenes.name: NOBODY OUTSIDE
lines: Records pin the past, a pointer walks it, the shortest arc sets each step, all from inside.
记录钉住过去，指针在其中行走，最短的弧定下每一步，全都在里面完成。
If every observer is part of the field, is anything left outside?
如果每个观察者都是场的一部分，外面还剩什么？

scenes.name: ONE TURN
lines: If nobody stands outside to watch, the turner must report on itself. So turn around once, and see what comes back.
如果外面没有人看着，转动者就只能自己报告。那就转一整圈，看看回来的是什么。

chapter.en: Part X · The observer is the field
chapter.zh: 第十部 · 不二与归元

scenes.name: HALF A TURN
lines: Picture two wheels linked two to one: the lower wheel z is always the square of the upper wheel w.
想象两只按二比一联动的轮子：下面那只 z，永远是上面那只 w 的平方。
Turn z a quarter round, and w turns an eighth: one plus i over root two, squared, is i.
让 z 转四分之一圈，w 只转八分之一：(1 + i)/√2 的平方，正是 i。
When z is home again, w has made only half a turn. It stops at minus one.
等 z 回到原处，w 只走了半圈，停在 −1。
Lean checks that this lift from one is the only continuous one, and that it ends at minus one.
Lean 检验了：从 1 出发的连续提升只有这一条，终点是 −1。
A second turn brings w home. It takes 720° to come back.
再转一圈，w 才回家。要 720° 才能回来。

scenes.name: THE OTHER SHEET
lines: So why did we think a full turn changes nothing? Because we watched the arrow, not the turner.
那我们凭什么以为，转一整圈什么都不变？只因为我们盯着箭头，没看转动的人。
The arrow, the world you see, is back. The turner has come round with its sign flipped.
箭头，也就是你看到的世界，回来了；转动者自己却换了号。
One turn returns the world. Only two return the one who turns.
一圈，世界回来；两圈，转动的人才回来。

scenes.name: INDRA'S NET
lines: Now many observers. Picture Indra's net: a jewel at every knot, each reflecting all the others.
现在是许多观察者。想象因陀罗网：每个网结一颗宝珠，每颗都映着其余所有的珠。
Give the jewels no addresses. Keep only how much each pair overlaps.
不给宝珠任何地址，只留下每两颗重叠多少。
Turn the whole net, and every overlap stays the same.
把整张网一起转，每个重叠都不变。
Lean checks the converse: nets with the same overlaps differ by one unitary move.
Lean 检验了反过来：重叠全都相同的两张网，只差一次幺正变换。
So the pairs fix the net. What's left is one move of everything at once, invisible from inside.
所以两两的重叠定下了整张网。剩下的只是全体一起的一次变换，网里谁也看不见。

scenes.name: NO RULER
lines: Chapter thirty-nine throws away the ruler and the origin, and keeps only comparisons.
第三十九章扔掉尺子和原点，只留下比较。
Two moves remain, under a few rules: carry the step from y to x onto z, and read how alike points are.
只剩两个动作，守几条规矩：把从 y 到 x 的那一步搬到 z 上；读出两点有多像。
On unit quaternions, one and i read a half; one and minus one read zero.
在单位四元数上，1 与 i 读出二分之一，1 与 −1 读出 0。
On top of those rules, ask five things. Order matters, and small steps join any two points.
在这些规矩之上，再要五条。次序有关；小步能连通任意两点。
Readings come as near zero as you like, and each point fits in five numbers whose dot products are the readings.
读数能任意接近零；每个点用五个数写下，它们的点积就是读数。
Last, no limit is missing. Then Lean checks that any such structure is the unit quaternions, point for point.
最后，取极限没有缺口。Lean 检验了：这样的结构一点对一点就是单位四元数。
That nature is built this way is the axiom itself: a model, not a proof.
至于自然是否就这样搭成，那是公理本身：一个模型，不是证明。

scenes.name: NO SEAT OUTSIDE
lines: The minus one where our half turn stopped is a point of this sphere. No watcher's seat is left outside it.
我们那半圈停下的 −1，正是这颗球上的一个点。球外没有留下旁观者的座位。
The observer is the field.
观察者就是场。
Then what lies outside every sphere?
那么，在所有的球之外，是什么？

scenes.name: OUTSIDE EVERY SPHERE
lines: So we climbed out of the last sphere. Is a bigger one waiting, like the next nesting doll?
我们爬出了最后一个球。外面会不会又是一个更大的球，像套娃的下一层？
In the book's reading, each finite sphere we closed left a small gap, pointing further out.
按本书的读法，我们合拢的每个有限的球，都留下一道小缝，指向更外面。

chapter.zh: 终章 · 在所有的球之外

scenes.name: THE ONE WHO COMPARES
lines: But why do we assume the outside must be one more thing to look at?
可我们凭什么以为，外面一定还是一件可以看的东西？
Look at what never changed. Act after act, someone held two arrows and compared them.
看看什么从没变过：一幕又一幕，总有人拿着两支箭头在比较。
A camera can photograph the whole room, except itself. The one comparing is never on the list.
相机拍得下整个房间，唯独拍不到自己；比较者从不在被比较的清单上。
So outside every sphere: no bigger sphere, no point out there, only the one who compares. A reading, not a theorem.
所以所有球之外，没有更大的球，也没有站在外面的点，只有比较者本身。这是读法，不是定理。

scenes.name: A BAG THAT ONLY GIVES
lines: Then does the climbing ever end? Try a bag you only take from.
那这场攀登会有尽头吗？试试一个只拿不放的袋子。
Cards two to nine. Each round, remove the largest card that some smaller card divides.
袋里是 2 到 9 的卡片。每一轮，拿走能被某张更小的卡片整除的最大那张。
Nine goes, then eight, six, four. Two, three, five, seven stay, and nothing moves again.
Lean checks the general case: on a finite set, a take-only update stops within as many steps as it had elements.
Lean 检验一般情形：有限集合上只删不添，至多走初始元素个数那么多步就停下。
Stopping is not emptying. Take only from a finite bag, and it must come to rest.
停下不等于清空。有限的袋子只拿不放，终将停下。

scenes.name: THE LEDGER
lines: Twelve stops, one ledger. Green where the Lean kernel checked a statement.
十二站，一本账。绿色是 Lean 内核检验过的陈述。
Purple where the book reads and interprets. Red where the question is still open.
紫色是本书的读法与诠释，红色是仍未解决的问题。
On this page: eleven green anchors, twelve readings, one open question.
这一页上：十一条绿色锚点，十二种读法，一个开放问题。
No ruler outside, no third point. Only two things compared, and the one who compares.
外面没有尺子，也不借第三点。只有被比较的两样东西，和那个在比较的人。
